title: 2025, Bluffdale City Council & RDA Meeting Agenda 09-10-2025

votes.motion: Council Member Aston moved to APPROVE the City Council Meeting Minutes, Board of Canvassers Meeting Minutes, and Meeting Agenda, as presented. Council Member Wilding seconded the motion
votes.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Council

votes.motion: Council Member Austin moved to APPROVE the Consent Agenda, as presented. Council Member Aston seconded the motion
votes.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Council

votes.motion: Council Member Wilding moved to APPROVE Resolution 2025-76 — Approving a Settlement Agreement between the City of Bluffdale and William J. Newman and William Mark Newman Related to the Acquisition of Property for the Widening and Improvement of 14600 South. Council Member Austin seconded the motion. Vote on the Motion: Council Member Austin- Yes, Council Member Aston-Yes, Council Member Wilding-Yes, Council Member Crockett- Yes, Council Member Lord-Yes
votes.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Council

votes.motion: Council Member Lord moved to APPROVE Ordinance 2025-20 — Approving the Proposed Text Amendment to Increase the Allowed Lot Coverage in the R-1-43 Zone, as amended to increase the Allowed Lot Coverage from 30% to 40% (Application 2025-31). Council Member Aston seconded the motion. Vote on the Motion: Council Member Aston-Yes, Council Member Wilding-Yes, Council Member Crockett-Yes, Council Member Lord-Yes, Council Member Austin-Yes
votes.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Council

votes.motion: Council Member Aston moved to APPROVE Ordinance 2025-21 — Approving the Proposed 2025 Parks, Recreation, and Open Space Plan. Council Member Wilding seconded the motion. Vote on the Motion: Council Member Wilding-Yes, Council Member Crockett-Yes, Council Member Lord-Yes, Council Member Austin-Yes, Council Member Aston-Yes
votes.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Council

votes.motion: Council Member Aston moved to APPROVE Ordinance 2025-22 — Approving the Bluffdale Active Transportation Master Plan. Council Member Wilding seconded the motion. Vote on the Motion: Council Member Crockett-Yes, Council Member Lord-Yes, Council Member Austin-Yes, Council Member Aston-Yes, Council Member Wilding-Yes
votes.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Council

votes.motion: Council Member Wilding moved to ADJOURN. Council Member Aston seconded the motion
votes.result: The motion passed with the unanimous consent of the Council
